meta.title: Acupuncture Point Protocols for Restoring Sleep and Spirit
meta.source_file: /Users/nuu/Downloads/Acupuncture resource/Acupuncture Point Protocols for Restoring Sleep and Spirit quick reference.rtf
meta.notes: Quick-reference clinical protocol export. Point codes follow Deadman-style notation (HE, P, KID, REN). Anmian carries multiple extraordinary-point codes in source material.

anchor_points.notes: Foremost point to calm and regulate the spirit. Acts as anchor whether disruption is deficiency (Heart blood or yin malnourishment) or excess (Heart fire, phlegm, phlegm-fire).
Classically combined with Shenmen HE-7 in many insomnia prescriptions. Tonifies qi and blood, nourishes Liver and Kidney yin, spreads Liver qi, harmonizes digestion.
Extraordinary point behind the ear. Source lists N-HN-54 / M-HN-34; Deadman 1e extract uses M-HN-54 for Anmian.
Prominent glabella point to calm the spirit. Classic insomnia trio: Yintang M-HN-3, Shenmen HE-7, Sanyinjiao SP-6.
Lowest channel point. Clears excess from the head; draws ascending yang, Liver fire, or qi downward. Traditional adjunct: massage before sleep or foot soaking in hot water.
Major point for regulating and calming the spirit.
Selected when defensive qi remains in yang channels ('excessive opening of the eyes'). Often paired with Zhaohai KID-6 to balance yin and yang.
Coupled vessel point paired with Shenmai BL-62 for sleep regulation.
